notes: A NAMING FIX. Version 0.8.73's setup wizard told you, on the very first screen, that "the product stays MoRaj Finance Multi" — the name of the sister edition, not this one. It now correctly says MoRaj Ledger. That is the whole change: no data, no ledger, no printed document and no setting was affected, and if you are already past the setup wizard you will never have seen it. Upgrade at your convenience. EVERYTHING IN 0.8.73 STILL APPLIES — backups that must survive your computer, the prompt to set one up before going live, hourly automatic backups, the warning when a cloud folder holds your ledger unencrypted, the printable backup recovery sheet, and the licensing fixes (an unreadable licence file now names your licence ID instead of claiming your evaluation ended, and a computer with a wrong clock no longer ends a trial permanently). There is NO database change: upgrading is simply installing over the old version.
